scope: Known complete class-diagram inputs. Optional native label refinement, no class or route movement. Proximity warnings are scale-normalized box-to-connector heuristics, not human preference or UML Property ownership. No broad competitor superiority claim.

copied_optional_cli.environment: Existing Windows, Python, Node, fonts and previously fresh-installed pinned core dependencies; existing Puppeteer Core. Not new OS or remote CI.

native_saved_edit.scope: One actual longer role-text save/import/reflow on an aligned 32-class native artifact, not desktop GUI certification

negative_results_retained: Applying a global strict affinity rule made rental and fulfillment label placement fail.
Choosing refinements from approximate label rectangles increased actual rental proximity warnings from 4 to 6; that variant was not published as a default.
Frozen competitor proximity bindings were incomplete on some Mermaid scenes; raw fragment counts differ by renderer and are not used as a superiority ranking.
remaining_limits: Fulfillment class placement still has two crossings and a wide canvas.
New complex holdouts, independent skill trials, human comprehension and full native GUI usability remain unproven.
The compiler remains a documented UML class-diagram subset.
